misreadings.quote: money kept for an emergency could also have shortened Gregor's debt and brought freedom from the job closer
misreadings.evidence: he could really have paid off more of the father’s debt to his employer and the day on which he could be rid of this position would have been a lot closer
misreadings.explanation: The text says the debt is the father's (earlier "my parents' debt"), not Gregor's own, though Gregor does work to pay it off.

result.note: Both versions follow the passage closely; the only imprecision is that the translation calls the debt Gregor's rather than his father's.
